night.method: DMS: XGBoost (depth 6, 600 rounds, eta 0.05) on 10 fine predictors aggregated to 1 km, 20 % most heterogeneous cells excluded; bilinear residual correction + 3 iterations of block conservation (|e_c| < 0.01 °C)

day_demo.comparison: anomalies (each product minus its mean over the common fine pixels) vs the Landsat C2 L2 fine composite (>= 2 clear scenes)
day_demo.note: MODIS Terra (~10:30 local solar time) and Landsat (~10:30 IST) differ in overpass and algorithm; anomalies remove the frame-wide offset

day.method: Landsat C2 L2 ST fine composite (observed) + overpass correction to 10:45 IST; pixels with < 2 clear scenes masked (not downscaled)

land_model.hindcast_truth: GHSL P2023A 2025 epoch (an extrapolated GHSL epoch, not an observation)
land_model.null_model: du proportional to u_2015 (same district demand)

allocation.rule: du_i = min(cap_i, k_d * S_i * N_i * eps_i), k_d by bisection; cap = 1 - u - forest - water (forest and water protected); donors cropland, barren, other vegetation in proportion to their current shares

day.method: OLS of the annual NCR satellite LST on era5_tmax + era5_swvl1; moving-block bootstrap (3-year blocks, 2000 draws, percentile CI); Theil-Sen univariate slope alongside

night.method: OLS of the annual NCR satellite LST on era5_tmin + era5_swvl1; moving-block bootstrap (3-year blocks, 2000 draws, percentile CI); Theil-Sen univariate slope alongside

cmip6.definition: delta = GCM Apr-Jun 20-year-window mean at the frame minus its 2016-2035 (2025) window

day.method: window mean 2024-2025 minus the 2001-2025 OLS trend of the ERA5-Land NCR annual era5_tmax at 2024.5

night.method: window mean 2024-2025 minus the 2001-2025 OLS trend of the ERA5-Land NCR annual era5_tmin at 2024.5
